reason: MailMessage.Body/IsHtmlBody are marked obsolete but no longer wired into any provider (Smtp/Azure) or the workflow task defaults, so any first/third-party code still setting message.Body directly will compile with only a warning yet silently send empty emails across every tenant that relies on it.
